lines.text: I left the porch light on so the house could pretend
Packed the rearview full of everything I couldn't say
Gas station coffee tastes like being seventeen
And the interstate hums a key I never played
I was the understudy in a play I wrote myself
Waiting in the wings of my own life
Mile markers counting down what I owe
Tonight the lead role rides at midnight
The radio only plays the songs we ruined
So I sing over them until they're mine
Dawn hit the windshield like applause
Kept the map folded to the page with no roads
